subject: Re: Kickoff: Light Field Neural Rendering productization — April status
body:
Hi Lucia, Santiago,

Status:

- Toy task ran green Mar 18; the JAX/CUDA bump cost us four days but the image is now standard.
- Shiny reproduction: 5 of 8 scenes at or above paper PSNR. The remaining three are the hardest reflective scenes; Ondrej traced most of the gap to our downsampled mirror of the dataset — we mirrored at half resolution to save the 2TB. Re-mirroring full-res now, ETA next week.

Trade-off to flag: full-res training roughly doubles per-scene GPU hours (about 190 H100-hours per scene at current settings). If the budget line is as covered as we think, I'd rather spend the hours than ship a softer quality bar to the LRB. But that's your call, not mine.

Also, heads-up that captures from the commerce partner arrive May 4, so eval infra needs to accept their capture rig format by then.

Katya
